lines.trans: Cindy can just sit back and listen—we always cap off the end of a birthday beautifully at karaoke!
Seung-chan, can you carry a tune?
I actually used to hear fairly often that I ought to become a singer.
Someone told you to become a singer? Who?!
A message used to pop up on the karaoke machine asking how I felt about debuting as a singer.
Hey, that message pops up for everyone automatically! Whenever I hit karaoke, I score ninety-nine or a hundred!
And what kind of song pick is this—is this really a song to sing at karaoke with your seniors?!
All right, time to rev up the engine! Our timing matches so well it lands right on the beat!
Front-row VIP tickets to my concert are super pricey—I never sing on cheap mics and speakers like these, except today is a special day!

words.gloss: since it is a special day!
